# TC.FluidInfo

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.FluidInfo"></a>

### TC.FluidInfo

Fluid metadata, not a tank's temperature or achievable recipe/boiler states.
Finite negative/equal temperature bounds and large finite gas thresholds are
preserved; default_temperature is also native minimum, with no extra alias.
No item weight, stack, rocket or spoilage fields appear on this record.

Extends: TC.PrototypeInfo

### default_temperature

Finite default/minimum degrees Celsius.

```text
number
```

### emissions_multiplier

Finite nonnegative native fuel-emissions multiplier.

```text
number
```

### fuel_value

Finite nonnegative joules per native fluid unit; preserve zero.

```text

```

### gas_temperature

Finite native gas-animation threshold in Celsius, not promised boiling point.

```text
number
```

### heat_capacity

Finite nonnegative joules per native fluid unit per degree Celsius.

```text
number
```

### max_temperature

Finite maximum degrees Celsius.

```text
number
```

### type

Exact fluid-namespace discriminator.

```text

```
